description: This PHP source file defines the I18NLanguageAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing internationalization languages within an admin module of the OrangeHRM system. It supports operations such as listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting language records, and utilizes a range of traits, models, and external dependencies for API handling, data validation, and database interaction.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints for managing internationalization languages in the admin module, including listing, fetching, updating, and deleting language records, leveraging traits, models, and validation rules.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all languages, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, specifically validating the 'activeOnly' boolean parameter and sorting/pagination options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove languages by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete method, ensuring IDs are provided as an array of positive integers.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single language record by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the ID parameter for fetching a single language.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a language record by setting it as added and updating the modification timestamp.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the ID parameter for updating a language.
